Choose the correct one-word substitution for the words in italics.
The professor specialized in the study of ancient societies.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Archaeology.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Anthropology"** refers to the study of humans, human behavior, and societies in the past and present. (मानव विज्ञान)
 
 
• **Example:** Anthropologists study the rituals and customs of indigenous tribes to understand their culture.
 
 
 
• The word **"Archaeology"** refers to the scientific study of ancient societies through their material remains, such as artifacts, structures, and monuments. (पुरातत्व विज्ञान)
 
 
• **Example:** Archaeologists discovered ancient pottery fragments during the excavation of the site.
 
 
 
• Hence, the professor who specializes in the study of ancient societies would be engaged in **"Archaeology"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Anthropology** (मानव विज्ञान): The study of humans, their behavior, and cultures across time.
 
 
• **Example:** The anthropology department is conducting research on the social structures of early civilizations.
 
 
 
• **Sociology** (समाजशास्त्र): The study of human society, its development, and functioning.
 
 
• **Example:** Sociology helps us understand the dynamics of modern urban life.
 
 
 
• **Paleontology** (जीवाश्म विज्ञान): The scientific study of fossils and ancient life forms.
 
 
• **Example:** Paleontologists uncovered dinosaur fossils from millions of years ago during their expedition.
